decisions.reason: The firm has already publicized a strong customer value case for this recently launched concept, so sunk investment and visible commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
A dedicated product page signals a relatively strong public commitment and sales effort, which in a German machinery firm supports continuing with the product despite the short track record.

Although it appears less prominently than A or B, it is still a very recent launch and management can plausibly attribute any weak uptake to normal ramp-up in capital equipment markets rather than product failure.

As a newly introduced mobile machine in an established equipment maker’s portfolio, it is likely to be retained while management gives the market more time and justifies the initial development effort.
